name: gazelle_run
description: Run Gazelle to generate or verify Bazel BUILD files. Gazelle is invoked via: bazel run @gazelle//:gazelle -- <mode>. Modes: 'update' (apply changes), 'diff' (show what would change, exits non-zero if dirty), 'fix' (apply fixes for deprecated constructs).

extra_args.description: Optional extra arguments passed after the mode flag, e.g. '-go_prefix github.com/Waryway/stack'

workspace_root.description: Absolute path to the Bazel workspace root. Defaults to auto-detected repo root.
